publication.title: Fresnel: A browser-independent presentation vocabulary for RDF

source_reading.scope: Presentation vocabulary rationale, core lenses/formats/selectors, complete multi-application implementation discussion and conclusion (§§1.2–5).

adjudication.basis: Fresnel is an exploration presentation component rather than a standalone new browser. The primary report documents implemented human lens switching, resource navigation and graph-lens interaction across Longwell, Horus, IsaViz and Cardovan, supporting inclusion as an implemented presentation approach with system-specific evidence.

descriptions.interaction: Longwell resource/facet navigation; Horus switch resource lenses; IsaViz hover lens changes focus/context rendering; Cardovan edit lens/property layout.
descriptions.guidance: Designer-specified lenses select/order properties, use context-appropriate labels and hide irrelevant details; optional SPARQL/FSL selectors.
descriptions.evaluation: Worked implementations and examples across four applications.

resources.notes: Current GET evidence only. HTTP success is not proof of repository code, valid license, reproducible installation or working demo; source identity review is required.
